server_rpc_chain.name: public.get_npc_profile_visible_v1(uuid)
server_rpc_chain.effect: Signed visible/reveal-only projection, original Stage1 version contains unsafe raw-secret optional reveal; must be replaced.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.get_my_player_characters_v2()
server_rpc_chain.effect: Can_edit grants full character+sheet, inventory/convert identity-only; Stage3 supersedes it to remove raw GM secret.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.get_npc_dossier_admin_v1(uuid)
server_rpc_chain.effect: GM-only guarded SECURITY DEFINER, row and original sheet.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.get_character_editor_narrative_v1(uuid)
server_rpc_chain.effect: Can_edit only; no GM secret; role-wide 5-column REVOKE applies even to Admin direct SELECT.

server_rpc_chain.name: private.can_access_creator_backstory_v1(uuid)
server_rpc_chain.effect: True creator provenance plus current can_edit or GM; server-owned trusted definer.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.can_edit_creator_backstory_v1(uuid)
server_rpc_chain.effect: Security invoker capability check; not a creator claim.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.get_my_player_characters_v2()
server_rpc_chain.effect: Editor sanitization of characters.secret; inventory-only no sheet.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.get_npc_profile_visible_v1(uuid)
server_rpc_chain.effect: Final safe projection; GM-authored revealed public clue only, never original characters.secret.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.get_character_secrets_v1(uuid[])/set_character_secret_v1(uuid,text)
server_rpc_chain.effect: GM guarded definer; never backfill/clear old GM secrets.

server_rpc_chain.name: public.create_player_character_with_private_backstory_v1(...)
server_rpc_chain.effect: Stage3 old wrapper REPLACED by #351 Story nonce-aware wrapper; source-original RED changed Story replay preserved.

known_source_conflict.item: Original I2C cannot be sequenced naively with immutable #324
known_source_conflict.because: #324 source gate demands unmodified public v2 MD5 0351f0a00acae023278e1b8b065b00c9 and subsequently replaces public v2 with reservation wrapper. I2C simultaneously requires private reservation table (from #324) while expecting public v2 MD5 0351f0a00acae023278e1b8b065b00c9.
